deviations.leakage: association matrix used in features/graphs/losses = training pairs only (released code used the full matrix incl. test pairs)
deviations.gip: miRNA view-1 (released file M_GSM = GIP of full HMDD v2.0 matrix) recomputed per fold from A_train
deviations.views: branch v receives its own features X^(v)=[S^(v),A] (released code fed view-1 features to both branches) [Eq.1-2]
deviations.knn: KNN hyperedges by cosine similarity, e_i = {v_i} U KNN(v_i,K) [Sec 2.3] (released: Euclidean)
deviations.avf: attention gate + learnable beta [Eq.16-18] (released: fixed 0.6/0.4 sum)
deviations.recon: Z_proj=W2 ReLU(W1 Z), S^=Z_proj Z_proj^T, L=||S-S^||_F^2 [Eq.19-21], lambda3=1 (released: cosine decoder, 0.15*MSE)
deviations.dyn_update: every 5 epochs: S^ min-max to [0,1], edges S^>0.5, hypergraphs rebuilt by KNN on [S^,A] [Sec 2.8] (released: every epoch if MSE change>0.01, hypergraphs never rebuilt)
deviations.loss: L = L_type + 1.0 L_intra + 0.3 L_inter + 1.0 L_recon [Eq.32] (+ released existence loss, paper does not define one); no label smoothing, no extra L2 term
deviations.type_loss: multi-label weighted CE over all known types of a pair [Eq.33], effective-number weights from training counts [Eq.34]
deviations.optim: Adam [Sec 2.9] (released AdamW); early stopping on a validation split carved from training data
deviations.protocol: CV_triplet and CV_type as two separate 5-fold protocols [Sec 3.2] (released: one pair split, 10% dropped)
deviations.types: number of association types C read from data (released: hardcoded 4)
